nodes.title: cases-list-screen.tsx's CaseSummary comment corrected to cite the current specification nodes
nodes.summary: Rewrote the stale two claims in CaseSummary's JSDoc — "an edge no governing node addresses" and "this task's own inference" — to quote what domain/knowledge/case-summary and rules/knowledge/a-case-summary-is-derived-from-its-existing-versions now state about the zero-version case, keeping the still-valid case-store.port.ts citation for why a case can reach zero versions.

nodes.title: Connector configuration warning states the object requirement, not a JSON-syntax claim
nodes.summary: Corrected INVALID_CONFIGURATION_WARNING in connector-configuration-detail-ready-view.tsx to state the registry's actual requirement (the stored value must be a JSON object) instead of the false-in-two-cases 'is not valid JSON' claim.

nodes.title: NewCaseDraftScreen's subject-field tests match the shared component's corrected behavior
nodes.summary: Four stale test assertions in two pre-existing spec files, still asserting the pre-fix "subject permanently disabled/labeled (fixed)" behavior, now match case-version-editor-form-fields.tsx's current, correct behavior (disabled={isBlocked}, labeled "Subject type").

nodes.title: Subject field honors isBlocked like every other declared attribute
nodes.summary: case-version-editor-form-fields.tsx's subject field now disables through isBlocked instead of unconditionally, and its label no longer claims the field is fixed.

nodes.title: cases-list-screen's CaseSummary comment cites the current specification nodes
nodes.summary: Four file-content tests, one per comment-content criterion, pin the corrected JSDoc above CaseSummary in cases-list-screen.tsx against the two stale phrases it must no longer carry and the two specification quotes it must now carry, following this codebase's own established convention for this exact criterion shape.

nodes.title: Connector-configuration warning states the object requirement, not a JSON-syntax claim
nodes.summary: Extends connector-configuration-detail-screen.spec.ts (and its shared test-support fixtures) to prove the corrected INVALID_CONFIGURATION_WARNING text and Save-blocking hold across all three isValid=false shapes — unparsable text, a syntactically valid array, and syntactically valid null — and that the underlying validity gate is unchanged.

nodes.title: NewCaseDraftScreen's subject-field tests match the shared component's corrected behavior
nodes.summary: Independently confirms, against case-version-editor-form-fields.tsx and both corrected spec files as they stand, that all four corrected assertions match the subject Input's current disabled={isBlocked}/"Subject type" behavior and that nothing else in either file changed; adds one new test proving this screen's own isBlocked (createMutation.isPending) is what the four corrected assertions' "false" actually depends on.

nodes.title: Subject field disables through isBlocked, not unconditionally
nodes.summary: Proof that case-version-editor-form-fields.tsx's subject field is enabled on an unblocked draft, disabled for each of isBlocked's four stated reasons, and no longer labeled as fixed.
